outcome: Maternal cardiac complications (transient heart failure, thromboembolism)
cohort: Eight pregnant women with Fontan physiology (totaling 15 pregnancies) treated at Seoul National University Hospital from June 1986 to September 2023.
finding: Pregnancy and planned delivery are feasible in selected women with Fontan circulation under close monitoring, with a 46.7% live birth rate and no severe maternal morbidity or mortality observed in this cohort despite some cardiac complications.
mod_finding: The majority of deliveries (85.7%) were performed via cesarean section.
